blocks.text: PIANO REMOVAL PRICING
What Actually Determines an Ajax Piano Removal Quote

c: The starting point is the piano itself. An upright or console is the more straightforward job — heavy, but usually manageable without full disassembly beyond clearing a doorway. A baby grand adds real complexity, since the legs and lid typically need to come off before it fits through a standard opening, meaning more time and a coordinated lift. A full grand piano is the most involved version, with legs, lid and often the pedal lyre separating from the body, each section still heavy enough to need multiple people carrying it carefully.

What’s specific to Ajax is how often that quote gets paired with a hard date rather than a loose window. A pre-listing job might need to land before a photographer shows up next Tuesday. A closing-driven job might need to land days ahead of possession, with margin for anything unexpected. None of that changes what’s charged — it changes how the crew books the visit, working backward from the real deadline rather than fitting the job in whenever’s convenient. The number and the date both get confirmed at the same free walkthrough, and both hold.

Bolton Piano Removal Questions People Actually Ask

items.q: Can you guarantee a piano is gone before our closing date?
a: That’s the whole point of how we schedule here. Tell the crew the closing date at the walkthrough and the job books backward from it with margin, so the piano is out well before anyone’s counting on it.

items.q: Our realtor flagged our piano as a problem for listing photos — can you help before the shoot?
a: Regularly. Pre-listing removal is common work for us, timed to have the room tidy before a listing goes live or a photographer shows up.

items.q: How much does piano removal cost in Ajax?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough and pairs with a real completion date, not a vague promise.

items.q: What's actually involved in moving a grand or baby grand piano?
a: Legs, the lid and sometimes the pedal lyre come off to fit through doorways and stairwells, and the piano moves on proper piano boards.

items.q: Do you charge extra for stairs?
a: No. Narrow staircases and multi-floor moves are factored into one flat quote at the walkthrough.

items.q: What happens to the piano once it's removed?
a: Donation partners are checked first for pianos that still play; only pianos beyond use go to recycling.

items.q: Can you remove a piano the same day I call?
a: Often, yes — trucks run seven days a week, 6AM to 11PM.

items.q: Can you coordinate directly with a realtor or a buyer's agent?
a: Yes — timelines can be confirmed directly with whoever’s managing the sale, so nothing falls through the cracks between parties.
